summary: This 8-K reports a debt offering by Kraft Heinz Foods Company (100%-owned subsidiary of The Kraft Heinz Company) of €500 million 3.500% senior notes due 2031 and €500 million 3.950% senior notes due 2034 under a firm-commitment underwriting agreement with Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs, and Merrill Lynch. The notes are expected to close on May 21, 2026. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction—no special situation—filed under Item 8.01 for other events. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change.
